definition.arithmetic_scope: Original full-gate baseline uses qualified operations exactly. Interventions use separate weighted sums of matrix action and additive input/bias forcing, in float32, without clipping or repair.
definition.gate_scope: Recompute dynamic gates causally on each intervened rollout own state. Initial gate means the first forecast transition, after measured-context initialization.

interventions.fixed_forcing: Matrix expert weights from current-state scheduler; input-matrix and bias expert weights=(.5,.5).
interventions.fixed_matrix: Matrix expert weights=(.5,.5); input-matrix and bias expert weights from current-state scheduler.
interventions.full_gate: Original qualified operation order; require exact saved prediction equality for all six baseline replays before any intervention.

definition.metrics: Cumulative standardized RMSE and physical RMSE degrees at each horizon, all six individual joint values; arithmetic means of three per-fit RMSEs are not ensembles.
definition.scope: Descriptive interventions on unchanged trained weights and already-exposed DEV. Not trained ablations, causal physical evidence, a fresh evaluation, or advancement.
